'''Operation 45RA''' was a plan conceived by [[Braig Farool]] to discredit the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the eyes of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galactic]] population, while at the same time gaining control of the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]] and the loyalty of the [[Shashay]].

==Background==
Ever since the [[Shashay]] became widely known in the galaxy, they were able to hide the location of their homeworld, [[Crytal Nest]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Shashay astrogators memorized the coordinates and entered them manually, whenever they brought a ship to their world. Between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Rebels contacted the Shashay to establish a secret base on their homeworld, where it would be hidden from the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]]. While the Shashay were sympathetic towards the Rebels, they refused at first.<ref name="TA" />

[[Braig Farool]], planetary [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Narg]] and head of [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] in the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]], learned two facts: that the Rebels had approached the Shashay about establishing a base on their homeworld, and that the Rebels had a spy in the entourage of the famous Shashay entertainer [[Crying Dawn Singer]].<ref name="TA" />

==The operation==
Farool enlisted the help of his brother and aide to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]], [[Nak Farool]], and the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Yearo Seville]]. He had planned to have Seville abduct Crying Dawn Singer and blame the Rebels, thus destroying any possibilities of cooperation between the two factions. Nak Farool approached Moff Nile Owen with the plan and let him play the hero and "rescue" Crying Dawn Singer to gain the loyalty of the Shashay for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. However, the Farool brothers planed to discredit him on the way and force him to resign, so they could take over the sector themselves.<ref name="TA" />

Seville and his pirate gang ambushed Crying Dawn Singer at the [[Sector Performing Arts Center]] and abducted him and his entourage to [[Najarka]]. After discovering the Rebel spy in the entourage, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[KL-6TLF7V/T]], he tortured the rest to death and left with Singer. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was left for Moff Owen to pick up. However, Seville didn't bring Singer to Moff Owen, but directly to Braig Farool, as the first step to discredit the Moff.<ref name="TA" />

As soon as the Rebels learned of the abduction, [[Zeke Rondel]], operating from [[Berrol's Donn/Legends|Berrol's Donn]] in the neighboring [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]], sent out a group of agents with the ''[[Worthless Fool]]''.

{{RPG|''[[The Abduction]]''}}
The Rebels discovered the abandoned droid on Najarka, but clashed with the arriving Imperials during their escape. The Rebels also picked up a broadcast message by Seville to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where he claimed to be a Rebel and demanded control of the Shashay homeworld be handed over to the Rebellion. The Shashay were enraged by the apparent betrayal of the Rebels, and several of their astrogators took Rebels ships hostage until Crying Dawn Singer would be released.<ref name="TA" />

The Rebels followed the broadcast message to the communication node in the [[Laim system/Legends|Laim system]], where they discovered the truth behind the plan and several additional faked messages, ready to be broadcast. Their next move was to rescue Crying Dawn Singer, who had been brought to Braig Farool on Narg.<ref name="TA" />

After losing the droid to the Rebels at Najarka, Owen discovered the faked messages and the plan to discredit him. Furious, he executed Nak Farool on the spot and set out to deal with Braig Farool.<ref name="TA" />

The Rebels managed to infiltrate Narg and the local TransGalMeg headquarters, rescued Crying Dawn Singer and defeated Braig Farool in the process. Before the Rebels could escape, Moff Owen made a last try to capture the Shashay, but the Rebels escaped.<ref name="TA" />
